theorems.name: Submission.dor_ims_sua_continuous_unit_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (K V : Set (Euclid P)) (β : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), IsCompact K → IsOpen V → K ⊆ V → ContinuousOn β K → (∀ x ∈ K, covectorEuclideanNorm (β x) ≤ 1) → ∃ g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, Continuous g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ tsupport g ⊆ V ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, g x = β x
